body.title: VS Code client: snapshot, renderer, webview message and fixtures
body.summary: Build in this order so the tests that break are updated in the same task: gateway and types first, then the renderer and write-handler dependencies, then the repoTrackerWrite webview message and its consent-gated route with the extension wiring, then the fixtures: seam test allowed set, the FakeGateway tests, model-tier-picker, repo-config, detail-renderers and activation tests.
acceptanceChecks: catalog keeps repoFields (empty when the daemon omits it) and the tracker section renders with local rows editable and policy and status rows read-only
repo-config.test.ts renderRepoConfig calls and makeWriteDeps supply the new dependencies, model-tier assertions pass unchanged, and tracker routing, refusal and error-message cases are added
detail-renderers.test.ts allows repoTrackerWrite and a new test shows the ghHost edit posts it; seam test allows exactly the five daemon calls; activation.test.ts passes
The three FakeGateway tests and the model-tier-picker test pass with the new fields

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/config/__tests__/gateway.test.ts: catalog keeps repoFields and the gateway calls repo.settings.get and repo.settings.set
vscode-plugin/src/config/__tests__/per-role-engine.test.ts: FakeGateway returns repoFields and the test passes unchanged
vscode-plugin/src/models/__tests__/model-tier-picker.test.ts: the stub catalog returns repoFields and the test passes unchanged
vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/repo-config.test.ts: tracker section, routing through the consent gate, refusal and error message
vscode-plugin/src/workspace/__tests__/activation.test.ts: extension wiring patterns still match with the added dependencies
vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/detail-renderers.test.ts: closed message set includes repoTrackerWrite and the ghHost edit posts it
vscode-plugin/src/config/__tests__/seam.test.ts: exactly the five daemon calls are allowed
vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/webview-host.test.ts: repoTrackerWrite is accepted and routed, errors become refusals, models.byRepo is unchanged
vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/repo-config.test.ts: the sign-in row is rendered read-only with status and reason
